# What is my EIS or SEIS investment really going to cost me?

> Free UK EIS and SEIS calculator: income tax relief you can actually use, CGT deferral or reinvestment relief, loss relief if the company fails, and the break-even sale price. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
